changelog: DeskAI v2.36.0 (Build 102): Today gets a real sky. A black night with stars and the moon in its real phase, clouds drifting across it with the wind; a sun that rises, crosses the sky and sets at your real sunrise and sunset; sunset colours, overcast, rain, storms with lightning, snow and fog from the weather now. The top is just the Chat/Today switch, the recipe is the pencil button at the bottom, the date is bigger and its colour follows the light, and video thumbnails have no black bars.
